candidate.content: In a kitchen environment, an exhaustive sequential search across multiple receptacle types (fridge, countertop, cabinets, coffeemachine, drawers) failed to locate the target egg. The egg was ultimately found and acquired from garbagecan_1 after 23 total actions and 15 candidate inspections. This demonstrates that food items can be located in atypical or non-storage receptacles such as garbage cans, and that prioritizing semantically likely containers first does not guarantee early discovery when the item is placed outside those priors.
candidate.scope: ALFWorld pick_cool_then_place_in_recep tasks in kitchen environments where the target object may reside in atypical receptacles; covers search through target acquisition only, excluding downstream cooling and placement steps.
